name: Knives
desc: While short and small, a knife is circumstantially deadlier than most due to its concealability.

name: Sabers
desc: Light and deadly, a Saber is a precision tool.

name: Cleavers
desc: Intimidating, long, and eerily quick. Cleavers encourage one to weave through many foes at once.

name: Polearms
desc: Efficient and refined, Polearms are a widely spread group of Weapons, united by their superior range.

name: Axes
desc: Simple and brutal Weaponry, an Axe is intended to leverage a less accurate but cruel edge.

name: Bludgeons
desc: While often crude in appearance, Bludgeons are designed to be highly effective tools against especially hard to crack foes.

name: Bows
desc: The Bow is the prince of Weapons, able to deliver death at long distances with almost no delay. Though, it requires strength, precision, and dedicated training to use well.

name: Arquebuses
desc: A modern Weapon, fit for the times. While less convenient, the elimination of tension and some skill makes these much easier to fire.
